```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = rprojroot::find_rstudio_root_file()) #set working directory to rproject root
```

# Load packages

```{r}
library('BiocManager') #for installing bioconductor packages like DESeq2
library('DESeq2') #for analyzing differential gene expression
library('tidyverse') #for data processing
library('openxlsx') #for excel files
library("viridis") #for colours on graphs
library("ggpattern") # for patterns on graphs
library("magick") # for patterns on graphs
library("ggtext") # for editing graph labels
```

# Load data

Here we load the BABA primed genes data for 1 dpi. We shall use the data for all genes primed by BABA in case 
some of the BABA primed metabolites are linked to the genes potentially also primed by SA and JA.

```{r}
load(file = "integration/BABA_primed_1dpi.RData")
```

Here we load the file with gene annotations from the output of trinotate

```{r}
trinotate <- read.csv(file = "GO_analysis/myTrinotate.csv")
```

# Subset trinotate data

Here we subset the trinotate data to include only genes that are primed by BABA at 1 dpi.
We also save this data for so we can get the closest matching transcripts to genes in relevant KEGG pathways 
using the trinotate annotations (mainly using blastx/p gene name and % ID). 

```{r}
trinotate_BABA_primed_all_1dpi <- 
  subset(trinotate, 
         trinotate$transcript_id %in% rownames(BABA_primed_all_1dpi))

write.csv(trinotate_BABA_primed_all_1dpi, 
          file = "integration/BABA_primed_trinotate_data/trinotate_BABA_primed_1dpi.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)
```

# Extract and save kegg ontology (KO) ids for KEGG search

```{r}
#extract KO ids as character vector
KOs <- trinotate_BABA_primed_all_1dpi$EggNM.KEGG_ko %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  filter(value != ".") %>% #remove non-annotated entries
  pull()

KOs <- gsub(KOs, pattern = "ko:", replacement = "") #remove unwanted characters

KOs <- unlist(strsplit(KOs, ",")) #remove commas and separate out KO ids

write.csv(KOs, "integration/BABA_primed_KO_data/K0_BABA_primed_1dpi.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

# Load and prep KEGG data

Have done a KEGG Mapper search (https://www.genome.jp/kegg/mapper/search.html)
using the KOs extracted above against the Reference database. This highlighted 
genes involved in key pathways. 

The key pathways selected are...

Isoquinoline alkaloid biosynthesis
AMPK signaling pathway
Tropane, piperidine and pyridine alkaloid biosynthesis
Nicotinate and nicotinamide metabolism
Tryptophan metabolism
Phenylpropanoid biosynthesis
Biosynthesis of various plant secondary metabolites
Anthocyanin biosynthesis
Flavonoid biosynthesis
Degradation of flavonoids
Isoflavonoid biosynthesis
Fatty acid biosynthesis
Pyrimidine metabolism
beta-Alanine metabolism
Fatty acid metabolism
Ubiquinone and other terpenoid-quinone biosynthesis
Terpenoid backbone biosynthesis
Diterpenoid biosynthesis
Carotenoid biosynthesis

These were chosen as they were found to have at least two KO matches to the primed KOs.

For each gene in a given pathway we also have the closest matching transcript based on the trinotate 
annotations (mainly using blastx/p gene name and % ID + eggnog score/e-value).

```{r, message=FALSE}
all_pathways_1dpi <- read.xlsx(xlsxFile = "integration/BABA_primed_KEGG_pathways.xlsx",
                               sheet = "1dpi_KO_genes")
```

Also need to organize the data into an easier to manage format as below to allow
plotting later.

### Tropane_piperidine_pyridine_alkaloid_biosynthesis

```{r}
Tropane_piperidine_pyridine_alkaloid_biosynthesis <- 
  
  all_pathways_1dpi[1:2] %>%
  
  #convert to tibble
  as_tibble() %>%
  
  #remove NAs
  na.omit() %>%
  
  #create col containing KO values
  mutate(
    KO = lapply(
      str_match_all(Tropane_piperidine_and_pyridine_alkaloid_biosynthesis
        , 'ko:\\s*(.*?)\\s* '
      ),`[`, , 2
    ),
    KO = unlist(KO)
  ) %>%
  
  #create gene acronym col
  mutate(
    acronym = lapply(
      str_match_all(Tropane_piperidine_and_pyridine_alkaloid_biosynthesis
        , ' \\s*(.*?)\\s*;'
      ),`[`, , 2
    ),
    acronym = unlist(acronym)
  ) %>%
  
  #create gene name col
  mutate(
    name = lapply(
      str_match_all(Tropane_piperidine_and_pyridine_alkaloid_biosynthesis
        , '; \\s*(.*?)\\s* \\['
      ),`[`, , 2
    ),
    name = unlist(name)
  ) %>%
  
  
  #create kegg EC value col
  mutate(
    EC = lapply(
      str_match_all(Tropane_piperidine_and_pyridine_alkaloid_biosynthesis
        , 'EC:\\s*(.*?)\\s*]'
      ),`[`, , 2
    ),
    EC = unlist(EC)
  ) %>%
  
  #select required cols
  select(closest.match,
         KO,
         acronym,
         name,
         EC) %>%
  
  #rename transcript column
  rename(transcript = closest.match)
```

```{r}
  #create kegg EC value col
  mutate(
    EC = lapply(
      str_match_all(Pyrimidine_metabolism
                    , 'EC:\\s*(.*?)\\s*]'
      ),`[`, , 2
    ),
    EC = unlist(EC)
  ) %>%
  
  #select required cols
  select(X28,
         KO,
         acronym,
         name,
         EC) %>%
  
  #rename transcript column
  rename(transcript = X28)
```

# Add fold-change + p-adj

Will merge the KEGG data prepared above with fold-change and p-adj values from DESeq2
for plotting. Will do this by looping through all dfs for the different pathways.

```{r}
#merge all pathway dfs into a list
pathways <- mget(c(
  "AMPK_signaling_pathway",
  "Anthocyanin_biosynthesis",
  "beta_Alanine_metabolism",
  "Carotenoid_biosynthesis",
  "Degradation_of_flavonoids",
  "Diterpenoid_biosynthesis",
  "Fatty_acid_biosynthesis",
  "Fatty_acid_metabolism",
  "Flavonoid_biosynthesis",
  "Isoflavonoid_biosynthesis",
  "Isoquinoline_alkaloid_biosynthesis",
  "Nicotinate_nicotinamide_metabolism",
  "Phenylpropanoid_biosynthesis",
  "Plant_secondary_metabolites",
  "Pyrimidine_metabolism",
  "Terpenoid_backbone_biosynthesis",
  "Tropane_piperidine_pyridine_alkaloid_biosynthesis",
  "Tryptophan_metabolism",
  "Ubiquinone_and_other_terpenoid_quinone_biosynthesis"
))

#create df of BABA primed transcripts with transcript ID as col
BABA_df <- BABA_primed_all_1dpi %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("transcript")

#add in fc and padj for each gene
pathways_fc_padj <- lapply(pathways, function(df) {
  df %>%
    arrange(transcript) %>%
    left_join(
      BABA_df %>% select(transcript,
                         log2_fold_change = 3,
                         padj = 7),
      by = "transcript"
    )
})

# Give back the names
names(pathways_fc_padj) <- names(pathways)
```

# Plot data

### Merge into single table and save

```{r}
pathway_gene_summary <- 
  bind_rows(
    pathways_fc_padj,
    .id = "pathway"
  ) %>%
  as_tibble()

write.xlsx(pathway_gene_summary,
           file = "integration/Output_BABA_primed_pathways_1dpi/pathways_summary_1dpi.xlsx")
```

### Find key genes linked to metabolites in table 3

```{r}
#load file containing metabolites and genes
metabolite_genes <- read.xlsx(xlsxFile = "integration/BABA_primed_KEGG_pathways.xlsx",
                                                   sheet = "metabolite_genes")

#compare with full summary of all pathways
shared_ECs <- intersect(metabolite_genes$EC_KO, pathway_gene_summary$EC) #shared ECs
shared_ECs

shared_KOs <- intersect(metabolite_genes$EC_KO, pathway_gene_summary$KO) #shared KOs
shared_KOs #no matches so dont include in filter below

shared_names <- intersect(metabolite_genes$gene_name_acronym, pathway_gene_summary$name) #shared gene names
shared_names

shared_acronyms <- intersect(metabolite_genes$gene_name_acronym, pathway_gene_summary$acronym) #shared gene acronyms
shared_acronyms

#filter by shared features
#need to do for pathways and metabolites as some mismatch
key_genes_pathways <- pathway_gene_summary %>%
  filter(EC %in% shared_ECs |
           acronym %in% shared_acronyms |
           name %in% shared_names) %>%
  select(-c(pathway)) %>% #drop the pathway col as only used this to get fold-changes/padj
  distinct() #drop duplicates rows as some pathways had same gene

key_genes_metabolites <- metabolite_genes %>%
  filter(EC_KO %in% shared_ECs |
           gene_name_acronym %in% shared_acronyms |
           gene_name_acronym %in% shared_names)

#merge the two so metabolites col and fold-changes/padj are all in one table
#note have to EC and name then merge as Naringenin matches three genes (all with EC 3.2.1.21)
#and uridine nucleosidase matches two metabolites (Nicotinic Acid and Nicotinate D-ribonucleoside)
# Join by EC
join_ec <- key_genes_metabolites %>%
  left_join(key_genes_pathways, by = c("EC_KO" = "EC"),
            relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  na.omit() #remove NAs where no match found

# Join by gene acronym/name
join_gene <- key_genes_metabolites %>%
  left_join(key_genes_pathways, by = c("gene_name_acronym" = "acronym")) %>%
  na.omit() #remove NAs where no match found

# Combine both joins
key_genes_all <- bind_rows(join_ec, join_gene) %>%
  mutate(EC = coalesce(EC, EC_KO)) %>% #merge EC cols
  mutate(acronym = coalesce(acronym, gene_name_acronym)) %>% #merge acronym/name cols
  #add an alt col for the metabolites where the precursor is given in brackets
  mutate(alt_metabolite = case_when(str_detect(metabolite, "Lariciresinol acetate") ~ 
                                      str_extract(metabolite, "(?<=\\().+?(?=\\))"),
                                    str_detect(metabolite, "Coniferyl alcohol") ~ 
                                      str_extract(metabolite, "(?<=\\().+?(?=\\))"),
                                    TRUE ~ metabolite)) %>%
  select(-c(gene_name_acronym, EC_KO)) %>% #remove unwanted duplicate cols
  distinct() #remove duplicate rows
```

### Plot the full dataset

```{r}
# create sensible pathway groupings for clarity on plot
pathway_levels <- c(
  # 1. Signaling
  "AMPK_signaling_pathway",
  
  # 2. Nucleotide Metabolism
  "Pyrimidine_metabolism",
  "beta_Alanine_metabolism",
  "Nicotinate_nicotinamide_metabolism",
  
  # 3. Lipid / Fatty Acid Metabolism
  "Fatty_acid_biosynthesis",
  "Fatty_acid_metabolism",
  "Ubiquinone_and_other_terpenoid_quinone_biosynthesis",
  
  # 4. Phenylpropanoids & Flavonoids 
  "Flavonoid_biosynthesis",
  "Isoflavonoid_biosynthesis",
  "Anthocyanin_biosynthesis",
  "Degradation_of_flavonoids",
  "Phenylpropanoid_biosynthesis",
  
  # 5. Alkaloids
  "Tropane_piperidine_pyridine_alkaloid_biosynthesis",
  "Isoquinoline_alkaloid_biosynthesis",
  "Tryptophan_metabolism",
  
  # 6. Terpenoids & Carotenoids
  "Carotenoid_biosynthesis",
  "Diterpenoid_biosynthesis",
  "Terpenoid_backbone_biosynthesis",
  
  # 7. General Secondary Metabolites
  "Plant_secondary_metabolites"
)

# Convert pathway column to factor with this order
pathway_gene_summary$pathway <- factor(
  pathway_gene_summary$pathway,
  levels = pathway_levels
)

# set up colours for the 19 pathways
colours <- c(
  "#8B00FF", 
  "#1E90FF", "#00BFFF", "#4682B4", 
  "#FFA500", "#FFD700", "#FF8C00", 
  "#FF4500", "#FF6347", "#DC143C", "#B22222", "#FF0000", 
  "#32CD32", "#3CB371", "#228B22",
  "#20B2AA", "#40E0D0", "#008B8B", 
  "#FF69B4"
)

# set up patterns for the 19 pathways (reusing 5 patterns based on largest group above).
patterns <- c(
  "none", 
  "checkerboard", "crosshatch45", "bricks", 
  "vertical", "crosshatch45", "bricks", 
  "crosshatch45", "none", "vertical", "bricks", "checkerboard", 
  "bricks", "checkerboard", "vertical",
  "none", "checkerboard", "crosshatch45", 
  "none"
)


# set up formatted labeles for key genes to highlight in red text
key_gene_names <- key_genes_all$acronym

axis_labels <- sapply(pathway_gene_summary$acronym, function(g) {
  if(g %in% key_gene_names) {
    paste0("<span style='color:red'>", g, "</span>")
  } else {
    g
  }
})

p <- pathway_gene_summary %>%
  
  select(acronym, log2_fold_change, pathway) %>% #select relevant cols
  # filter(log2_fold_change > 1 | log2_fold_change < -1) %>% #filter by FC to improve clarity
  
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = fct_reorder(acronym, log2_fold_change), #order by FC
                       y = log2_fold_change, 
                       fill = pathway, # colour and pattern by pathway
                       pattern_type = pathway)) +
  
  geom_col_pattern(position = position_dodge2(padding = 0), #split bars in half for repeats 
           colour = "black", #black outline on bars
           width = 0.7, #more space between bars (thinner bars)
           pattern = "magick",
           pattern_scale = 1.5, #set pattern options
           pattern_fill = "white"
           ) + 
  
  #fold-change thresholds
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1.0, linewidth = 3, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -1.0, linewidth = 3, linetype = "dashed") +
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = colours) + #use own colours
  scale_pattern_type_manual(values = patterns) + #use own patterns
  
  coord_flip()+ #horizontal bars
  xlab("Gene") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = axis_labels) + #add custom labels with key genes highlighted
  ylab("log2 fold-change") +
  
   theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), #remove major grid lines
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), #remove minor grid lines
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"), #light grey background to match other graphs
        axis.line.x = element_line(), #add line to x-axis
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 40), # Change x-axis label size,
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 40), #change x-axis title size
        axis.text.y = element_markdown(size = 40), #change y-axis label size, markdown so key genes highlighted with HTML/CSS tags
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 40), #change y-axis title size
        legend.position = "none"
        )

ggsave(filename = "integration/Output_BABA_primed_pathways_1dpi/BABA_primed_pathways_1dpi_all_genes.pdf",
       p, device = pdf, width = 40, height = 80, limitsize = FALSE)
```

### Plot key genes

```{r}
metabolite_patterns <- c("hs_vertical", "horizontalsaw", "hs_horizontal", "verticalsaw", 
                         "checkerboard", "gray100", "none", "bricks")


p <- key_genes_all %>%
  
  select(acronym, log2_fold_change, metabolite, alt_metabolite) %>% #select relevant cols
  
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = fct_reorder(acronym, log2_fold_change), #order by FC
                       y = log2_fold_change,
                       pattern_type = metabolite)) +
  
  geom_col_pattern(position = position_dodge2(padding = 0), #split bars in half for repeats 
           colour = "black", #black outline on bars
           fill = "lightblue",
           width = 0.9, #more space between bars (thinner bars)
           pattern = "magick",
           pattern_scale = 2, #set pattern options
           pattern_fill = "black",
           pattern_frequency = 0.2
           ) + 
  
  #fold-change thresholds
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1.0, linewidth = 3, linetype = "dotted", col = "red") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -1.0, linewidth = 3, linetype = "dotted", col = "red") +
  
  scale_pattern_type_manual(values = metabolite_patterns) + #use own patterns
  
  # add metabolite text labels
  geom_text(aes(label = alt_metabolite,
                hjust = ifelse(log2_fold_change > 0, -0.1, 1.1)),  # right if +ve, left if -ve
            size = 10,
            position = position_dodge2(width = 0.9, preserve = "single") #prevent label overlap on split bars
            ) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(-3,9,1.5), #adjust axis breaks
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.12, 0.1))) +  # add more space at ends of axis for labels
  
  coord_flip()+ #horizontal bars
  xlab("Gene") +
  ylab("log2 fold-change") +
  
   theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), #remove major grid lines
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), #remove minor grid lines
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"), #light grey background to match other graphs
        axis.line.x = element_line(), #add line to x-axis
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 40), # Change x-axis label size,
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 40), #change x-axis title size
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 40, margin = margin(r = 40)),#change y-axis label size + increase label margin 
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 40), #change y-axis title size
        legend.position = "none" # remove legend
        )

ggsave(filename = "integration/Output_BABA_primed_pathways_1dpi/BABA_primed_metabolite_genes_1dpi.pdf",
       p, device = pdf, width = 45, height = 20, limitsize = FALSE)
```
